hero.description: Aevia helps small businesses and independents, in France and Latin America, with three simple services: a website that gets you found, an AI customer desk that answers day and night, and a security check of your website. Take the one you need, or all three.

products.section_title: Three services. Pick the one that fits your situation.
products.section_sub: Each one works on its own. Start with what you are missing, add the others later if you need them.
products.launch_tagline: No website yet, or one that brings you no one?
products.launch_desc: We start from a professional template, adapt it to your colours and content, and put it online in 7 days. Nothing technical for you to handle.
products.launch_f1: Showcase site, online shop or campaign page
products.launch_f2: Your colours, your text, your photos
products.launch_f4: Built for Google and for mobile
products.inbox_tagline: Missing calls and messages when you are busy or closed?
products.inbox_desc: A customer calls on Saturday night, writes on your site at midnight or on WhatsApp on Sunday: an AI answers right away, understands the request and alerts you when it matters.
products.inbox_f1: Phone, WhatsApp, Instagram, email and your website chat, in one place
products.inbox_f2: Answers within seconds, day and night
products.inbox_f3: Flags the customers ready to buy
products.security_tagline: Not sure your website is properly protected?
products.security_desc: Enter your website address: in 60 seconds you get a clear report with a score out of 100, the weaknesses found and what to do about them. Nothing to install.
products.security_f3: The fixes to make, most important first

how.title: How it works
how.step1_title: You tell us about your business
how.step1_desc: By message or in a 30-minute call. You talk about your customers and your needs, we handle the technical side.
how.step2_desc: Your site is online in 7 days, the AI desk is connected to your channels, the security check runs in a minute. You approve every step.
how.step3_desc: Customers find you, every message gets an answer, and you are alerted when it matters.

cta.title: Not sure what you need?
cta.desc: Describe your business in a few lines: we will tell you honestly which of the three services would help, or whether none would.
